lesson_title: The Real Cost of a Commute
hook_text: A 30 km drive to work. How much does the fuel cost in a month?
clip_script: Thirty kilometres there, thirty back, twenty-two days: 1 320 kilometres. At 8 litres per 100 kilometres, that is about 105.6 litres. At R22 a litre, more than R2 300, before insurance or parking. Now multiply by thousands of cars, most carrying one person, all on the same highway at seven in the morning. That is congestion: wasted hours, wasted fuel and a brown haze of smog on winter mornings. Share the car with three colleagues and the cost falls to about R580 each.
visual_style: A whiteboard highway filling with cars, a fuel gauge emptying, and a brown smog layer settling over a city skyline.
pacing: Builds from the calculation to the city-wide problem.
